Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner fell into looping behavior and failed to consolidate and finalize the result despite having sufficient corroboration. By Step 8, multiple authoritative sources (Wikipedia and Britannica) confirmed the first publication as 1866, with UCL clarifying the 1866 serialization vs. 1867 book edition. Instead of concluding, the Planner repeated essentially the same instructions in Step 9 and onward, re-delegating redundant checks and not delivering the final answer. This over-verification and failure to terminate the task led to an incomplete/wrong solution (no resolved year provided).
